me.label: Your account
app.notYet: This part of the panel is not built yet.
err.network: The server didn’t answer. Check the connection and try again.
acc.title: Your account
acc.lead: Who you are here, how you sign in, and the tokens your AI clients use to reach memory as you.
acc.name: Name
acc.profileNote: Name and email come from your sign-in provider. To change your role or spaces, ask an administrator.
acc.rootNote: You signed in with the server’s administrator token, which belongs to no account: there is no profile or memory to show here. Link a sign-in method to an administrator account to use the rest of the panel.
gate.tagline: Team memory your agents can recall — every line traceable to where it came from.
gate.noProviders: No sign-in providers are set up on this server yet.
gate.fine: Signing in doesn’t grant access by itself. Your administrator decides who gets in and which spaces they see.
gate.admin.title: Administrator sign-in
gate.admin.redirected: No administrator has linked a sign-in method yet, so /signin brought you here.
gate.admin.hint: The server’s MEMGRES_ADMIN_TOKEN, or your personal mgk_ token.
gate.admin.refused: This token can’t sign in here. It has to be the server’s administrator token or the personal token of a superadmin or user manager.
gate.admin.throttled: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
mem.search: Search this space — words, a title or a path
mem.noSpaces: You can’t see any spaces yet.
mem.noSpacesHelp: Spaces are shared with you by their owners or an administrator. Once one is, it appears in the sidebar.
mem.gone: This space is no longer available to you.
mem.recordGone: This record is no longer here — it may have been moved or removed. Reload the space.
mem.truncatedNote: The map shows the first {shown} of {total} records. Search and the local view still reach all of them.
viz.noD3: The graph couldn’t start. The tree list works without it.
crumbs.label: Path to the root
suggest.text: {records} — the whole space is busy to read.
suggest.noSel: Pick a record and look at its neighbours instead.
suggest.busiest: Local view of the most linked
local.needSel: Select a record first — the local view is built around it
tip.below: path without its own record · {records} below
insp.noHits: Nothing in this space matches. Try other words.
insp.spaceNote: Node size follows the number of links. A dashed outline is a path with no record of its own. Select anything to fade everything unrelated.
insp.dangling: Nothing is written at this path yet
tok.title: Tokens for AI clients
tok.none: No tokens yet. Create one for each device or client you use.
tok.revokeConfirm: Revoke “{label}”? Anything using it stops working immediately.
tok.note: One token per device: losing a laptop means revoking one token, not all of them. Tokens expire on their own; revoked ones stop working immediately.
tok.label: Device or purpose
tok.ceiling: A token never reaches further than your account: in a space you can only read, a write token only reads.
tok.copyNow: Copy it now — it won’t be shown again
tok.fingerprint: Only a fingerprint of it is stored; nobody can show it to you again.
tok.noMcpUrl: This server doesn’t say where its MCP endpoint is, so the address below is an example. Ask your administrator for the real one.
tok.copyFail: Select the token and copy it
